name: Storzen – Shop Customizer for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen – Shop Customizer for WooCommerce is a flexible and powerful plugin that allows store owners and developers to design visually stunning WooCommerce product displays. With Storzen, you can create custom product sections for your homepage, landing pages, or promotional campaigns—all without touching a single line of code.
Instead of the default WooCommerce layouts, you gain full control over product presentation, improving user engagement, UX, and conversions. Integrated seamlessly with Elementor, Storzen empowers anyone to design professional WooCommerce shops quickly and efficiently.

Key Features

Grid Layouts – Flexible and fully customizable product grids.
Carousel Sliders – Interactive sliders for featured or trending products.
Tabbed Products – Organize products by categories, latest, best sellers, or featured items.
List View Layout – Present products in detailed list format for comparisons.
Responsive Design – Fully optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Elementor Integration – Drag-and-drop widgets for easy page building.

Use Cases

Homepage Design – Engage visitors with attractive product sections.
Landing Pages – Showcase targeted products in high-converting layouts.
Product Showcases – Highlight specific categories, collections, or seasonal items.

Why Choose Storzen?

No Coding Required – Perfect for beginners and designers.
Fully Responsive – Works on all devices.
Seamless Elementor Integration – Drag-and-drop widgets for fast setup.
Boost Conversions – Improved product presentation = higher sales.
Easy Product Filtering – Display products by categories, tags, or featured items.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. WooCommerce and Elementor must be installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does Storzen require WooCommerce to work?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for Storzen to function properly.

Do I need Elementor to use Storzen?

Elementor is recommended to unlock all widgets and layout features, as Storzen is built to enhance the Elementor and WooCommerce experience.

Is Storzen beginner-friendly?

Yes, it’s designed with a user-friendly interface suitable for users of all experience levels.

Can I create product sliders or tabbed sections?

Yes, Storzen includes various layouts such as product grids, carousels (sliders), and tabbed product sections.

Is it mobile responsive?

Absolutely. All layouts created with Storzen adapt automatically to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I display specific products or categories?

Yes, you can easily filter and display products by category, tag, featured status, best sellers, and more.

Does Storzen work with all WooCommerce themes?

It works seamlessly with most well-coded WordPress themes that support WooCommerce and Elementor.

Do I need coding skills?

No coding skills are required. Storzen allows you to customize your shop fully through a visual interface.

Where can I get support?

Support is available via the official WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Renamed plugin to Storzen – Shop Customizer for WooCommerce.
  • Updated plugin slug to storzen.
  • Updated all internal prefixes from WCSB_/wcommero_ to STZN_/storzen_.
  • Updated text domain to storzen throughout all files.
  • Updated PHP namespace to DevHasib\Storzen\Elementor.
  • Updated Elementor widget category and filter hooks.

1.0.3

  • Fixed inline style output to use wp_add_inline_style().
  • Fixed Elementor widget namespaces to avoid collision with Elementor core namespace.
  • Added Requires Plugins header for WooCommerce and Elementor.
  • Documented all third-party libraries in readme.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
